title: The Righteous Will Live by Faith

request.style: English, male solo with warm choir, harp, piano, cello, flute, strings, solemn and hopeful, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I am under obligation to the wise
And to the foolish, both without disguise
I am eager to preach the good news to you
Who dwell in the city of Rome, this is true

[Pre-Chorus]
I am not ashamed of the gospel I hold
It is the power of God, a story of old

[Chorus]
For in the gospel the righteousness of God is revealed
From faith to faith, as the ancient text sealed
The righteous will live by faith, so the soul may be free
The righteous will live by faith, eternally

[Verse]
For the wrath of God is revealed from on high
Against the ungodliness, the wickedness of the lie
People suppress the truth with their wickedness and sin
But what can be known about God is plain within

[Pre-Chorus]
He has made it plain to them, clear to see
The invisible qualities, the eternal decree

[Chorus]
For in the gospel the righteousness of God is revealed
From faith to faith, as the ancient text sealed
The righteous will live by faith, so the soul may be free
The righteous will live by faith, eternally

[Bridge]
Since the creation of the world, they have been seen
Understood from what he has made, in between
His eternal power and divine nature stand
So they are without excuse in this promised land

[Chorus]
For in the gospel the righteousness of God is revealed
From faith to faith, as the ancient text sealed
The righteous will live by faith, so the soul may be free
The righteous will live by faith, eternally

[Outro]
First for the Jew, then for the Greek
The power of God, the salvation we seek
